region_applicability.evidence_basis: publisher title, README region inventory and all 867 numeric sample-coordinate rows; coordinates remain reported-only because the publisher does not declare a datum or CRS

scientific_notes: The workbook contains 737 surface-sediment rows although the README prose totals the eight stated regions to 737 while one nearby sentence says 738; the adapter binds the actual row population and reports the discrepancy rather than inventing a row.

The source supplies reported coordinates across Junggar, Tarim, Qaidam, eastern Tibetan Plateau, Alxa, Hetao, northeastern deserts and the Loess Plateau, but no datum, CRS or positional uncertainty; coordinates remain reported-only.

As uses HG-AFS after aqua regia; Cr uses XRF on fused pellets; Cu, Ni, Pb and Zn use ICP-MS after four-acid digestion. The README does not map Hg to a technique, so Hg method fields remain explicitly missing.

Dataset-level QC reports 3% field duplicates, blind laboratory replicates and multiple soil, gold and PGE reference materials, but row/batch links and acceptance results are not published and are not inferred.
This source materially improves northern and western China coverage but is not a probability sample or complete national grid.

scientific_notes: The product reports total Hg in dry-weight ng/g for less-than-75-micrometre top and bottom outlet sediment; it is not a regular national grid.

The header reports a 0.01 ng Hg mass detection limit, not a concentration detection limit; the adapter does not incorrectly store 0.01 ng/g as a row threshold.
TOS and BOS horizons and all duplicate codes remain explicit. QA/QC duplicates are not counted as independent sites.

Coordinates are declared GDA94 geographic (EPSG:4283) and are canonicalized to EPSG:4326 numerically unchanged under the registered identity-tolerance policy gda94-geographic-wgs84-identity-v1; the raw GDA94 columns remain in every record.

scientific_notes: Dissolved, suspended, extractable and total fractions remain separate comparison bases and must not be merged silently.

Cr-VI is retained in Chromium.csv but excluded from elemental Cr output because a species-specific measurement is not interchangeable with total chromium.

Station metadata contain 35 exact duplicate rows across 35 IDs; the adapter preserves both source locators but uses one identical station fact set.
The v3 description claims 22,982 stations and 622 parameters, while the selected metadata files contain 22,981 station rows and 621 parameter rows; the one-record differences remain explicit.
GEMStat is voluntarily contributed and geographically uneven; the seven-element subset is not uniform global freshwater coverage.
